purpose: Test whether restricting task adaptation to the classifier improves held-out training-pool accuracy, without searching the expanded development set.

evidence.interpretation: No demonstrated severe overfitting; this is a controlled adaptation-capacity comparison, not a claim that freezing must help. Online augmented training accuracy is not directly comparable to deterministic validation accuracy.

data.pool: Only rows with split=train in the frozen V10 manifest, 19120 images; materialize a training-only manifest before any CV worker starts.
data.groups: Reuse frozen label-blind near-duplicate group IDs. Not person-independent CV.
data.row_order: Frozen manifest order; bind all fold member/image/group hashes in executable plan before training.
data.outer_development: 4782 frozen V10 validation images; no CV or selection-stage metric evaluation and no intermediate checkpoint selection using them.
data.internal_test: Never access internal held-out images or labels.
data.external_answers: Never access external answers; no relabeling or additional exclusions.

initialization.model: Official HSEmotion EfficientNet-B2 AffectNet7 only, reset independently for each run

arms.full: All model parameters trainable, BN running statistics frozen exactly as V10; backbone LR=1e-5, classifier LR=1e-4.
arms.fc_only: Only classifier weight and bias trainable, LR=1e-4; all backbone parameters and buffers frozen and backbone in eval mode; assert exact tensor invariance.

interpretation_boundary: This compares two complete adaptation regimes. fc_only eval disables any stochastic layers that actually exist; GPU smoke must list actual dropout/drop-path configuration. The pinned HSE constructor currently defaults both rates to zero. If both are zero and BN statistics are frozen in both arms, do not claim a stochastic-regularization difference. Report observed mode differences rather than assuming them.

common_settings.candidate: Only final epoch12 EMA per run, original/flip equal probability mean
common_settings.weak_augmentation: Exactly the frozen V10 implementation and parameters
common_settings.tail: Actual group-size denominator, never drop tail
common_settings.pairing: Within each fold use identical row shuffle and deterministic image augmentation for both arms. Scheduler and EMA count actual successful optimizer updates.

execution.resume: Nearest complete epoch only, with optimizer/scaler/RNG/EMA and immutable source/input/config bindings
execution.gates: Freeze executable plan and source/input hashes; independent code/math/data review; real GPU two-update smoke for each arm including freeze checks; then serial launch.
execution.estimation: Approximately 7-10 GPU hours including possible refit, provisional until smoke timing; not a promised finish time.

selection.oof: Each of 19120 training-pool members appears once in final OOF predictions per arm; fold models may never train on their held-out groups.
selection.rule: Choose fc_only only when its pooled OOF correct_count is strictly higher than full and it wins at least 2 of the 3 folds; all ties/defaults select full.
selection.lock: Write and hash cv_selection.json before any outer-development confirmation or competition inference.
selection.if_full_selected: Preserve verified V10 final epoch12 EMA and CSV, which already used exactly the full-pool recipe. Do not repeat identical refit or reevaluate old checkpoints.
selection.if_fc_only_selected: From official initialization train fc_only on all 19120 for fixed 12 epochs with the common settings; final EMA is the sole outer-development candidate. Adopt only if its correct_count strictly exceeds V10 3240/4782; otherwise preserve V10.
selection.competition: Only an adopted new candidate receives fresh 7065-image original/flip inference. Otherwise copy verified V10 predictions. No weight/temperature/TTA/epoch search; no old task-model probability fusion.
selection.full_reuse_contract: Mandatory exact protocol equivalence: ordered training membership and image hashes; official initialization and runtime; seed42 and augmentation offset100, augmentation and RNG management; uniform CE/smoothing0; BN policy and trainable parameters; AdamW parameter groups, weight decay and clipping; micro16/effective32 and tail denominator; successful-update learning-rate schedule; AMP/scaler; EMA initialization/update; fixed epoch12 EMA and fixed two-view probability mean. Verify all pinned V10 artifacts and both delivery receipts. If any part differs or cannot be established, stop reuse and record the mismatch; do not silently add refit, change training settings, or claim a matched full control.

delivery.requirements: Verify complete epoch histories, actual AdamW/AMP/EMA counters, freeze invariance, all source/model/probability/member/image/group hashes, OOF coverage and selection rule. CSV exactly7065 rows ID/Emotion, exact template ID order, integer0..5 equal probabilities.argmax; fixed original/flip mean and full output recipe hashes.
delivery.old_v8_comparison: Still unranked on a common independent split; never directly compare old2656 validation score to new4782 score.
delivery.communication: Open verified CSV in this chat; no Kaggle upload. Report OOF and outer-development outcomes separately; no promise of Kaggle improvement.
